live.claim: The three-clearing forecast is a readable authored combat rule rather than generic enemy volume.
live.baseline: A broad Wobblewoods platform showed three separate circles, exactly two Mood Clouds in each and one gold current clearing. The action label and HUD stated the full exact rule.
live.action: Started the real encounter, moved between the circles and used Human Panzer attacks.
live.observed: Progress changed 0/6 to 2/6 with only the second circle becoming gold, then 4/6 with only the final circle gold, and finally 6/6. The next-clearing announcement named 1 of 3 and 2 of 3 transitions.

live.claim: One area attack cannot cascade across a newly activated forecast clearing.
live.baseline: Six low-health staged encounter clouds occupied all three nearby circles.
live.action: Used one Breakfast Avalanche from within the first circle.
live.observed: The attack defeated exactly the two active-circle clouds, stopped at 2/6, displayed NEXT CLEARING LIT and left both later pairs alive. A deterministic 0.45-second transition gate protects every multi-target damage path from same-action progression cascades.

live.claim: The conclusion presents two explicit permanent world rules without hidden correctness or pressure rewards.
live.baseline: Completing 6/6 opened Tomorrow's Weather Is Missing as a permanent saved-world decision.
live.action: Read both outcomes and chose Build the Public Forecast Lattice.
live.observed: The modal named the 1.1-second gold warning and the alternative 10-second rainbow shelter, stated there was no hidden correct answer, and completion exposed Permanent weather pact + Raincheck-4 witness rather than currency or consumables.

live.claim: The selected warning rule is visible in ordinary combat and persists through an ordinary canonical reload.
live.baseline: The saved region HUD read MEMORY: WARNINGS ON and a real Mood Cloud announced LOCALIZED FEELINGS.
live.action: Observed separated states around one puddle spawn, then navigated to the canonical route and continued the same saved world.
live.observed: A bright gold warning ring appeared around the hero before a later FEELINGS: DAMP state. The canonical reload again displayed MEMORY: WARNINGS ON with the hero at 100 health in the invulnerable QA observation. Browser warnings and errors were exactly empty.

limitations: The rolling-frame capability was unavailable. The exact 1.1-second arm value is deterministic source/test evidence; separated screenshots prove only the visible warning and later armed states.
The warning-lattice branch was exercised live. The rainbow-shelter duration, damage blocking and save contract are deterministic evidence.
Production Blender character rigs and animation assets remained unavailable, so this pass deepened authored gameplay while preserving procedural character stand-ins.

visualReceipt.nextCheapestTest: When rolling capture exists, measure warning creation to first damaging tick without replacing deterministic assertions.
